caption: The drawing depicts a uniform consisting of a red jacket with gold buttons arranged in a vertical line down the center. The collar is blue with the number “22” in yellow or gold on each side. There is a wide blue belt or sash around the waist, fastened with a rectangular gold-colored buckle that has the letter “I” prominently displayed in the center. The sleeves are voluminous and red with blue cuffs, each cuff outlined and buttoned with small gold buttons. The headgear is a red cap with a blue band and the number “22” in gold at the front, adorned with white detailing and a white or light blue plume or decoration at the top. No face or hands are depicted; the space under the hat and above the collar is empty. The background is a plain, unadorned beige or off-white color.
title: Full Dress Uniform
